=== about
A client ignores an unknown event, an unknown key and a field it does not use, and an event id does not change the result.
=== page
<p id="x">0</p>
=== input
event: ypy-from-the-future
data: x 1

event: ypy-patch-elements
data: colour red
data: selector #x
data: mode inner
data: elements ok

event: ypy-patch-elements
id: 7
data: mode inner
data: selector #nowhere
data: elements <b>no</b>

=== dom
<p id="x">ok</p>
